text:
harper: quick check — onboarding goliath-7b failed schema gate, can someone look? weights are uploaded but validator is throwing type errors.
harper: seeing: "config.json: field \"vocab_size\" expected integer but got string" and "pad_token_id missing" as separate errors.
anika: I can take a look, which paths?
harper: weights: gs://redwood-model-assets/goliath-7b/v1/weights-0001.bin
harper: tokenizer: gs://redwood-model-assets/goliath-7b/v1/tokenizer.json
harper: config: gs://redwood-model-assets/goliath-7b/v1/config.json
dave: fwiw our schema validator will reject strings for ints — sometimes exporters write numbers as strings. quick fix is to coerce, but we should patch the source.
sam: can you paste the config snippet here?
harper: sure — here's the exact fragment the gate flagged:
```json
{
  "vocab_size": "50020",
  "pad_token_id": null,
  "max_sequence": "4096",
  "model_type": "goliath",
  "hidden_size": 6144
}
```
mantra: (bot note) uploaded asset checks started for goliath-7b/v1 — see pipeline 8921
anika: ok — three things: 1) pad_token_id null -> should be an int or omitted, 2) vocab_size and max_sequence are strings, 3) hidden_size looks good.
anika: I'll run a quick sanitizer to coerce numeric strings and drop null pad_token_id if tokenizer defines special tokens.
maria: tokenizer.json shows "special_tokens_map": {"pad_token":"<pad>"} and tokenizer vocab length 50020 (ints) — so pad_token_id should be assigned. I can map pad_token to id 50019 and update config.
dave: is it safe to auto-assign pad id? might break downstream tests — prefer to compute token id from tokenizer file and fail if mismatch.
anika: Agreed. I'll implement: read tokenizer.json -> find pad token id -> set pad_token_id if missing/null; coerce numeric strings -> ints; then re-run schema lint.
harper: timeline? this blocks canary to Dedicated.
anika: give me 30 mins to run sanitizer and post a patched config.
sam: I'll also add a quick unit test to the gate that asserts numeric types for those fields.
amika: (typo) ignore — meant anika :)
deploy-bot: pipeline 8921 — sanitizer job queued by @anika.
anika: updated config posted: gs://redwood-model-assets/goliath-7b/v1/config.json.patch (will attach PR after verification).
harper: thanks. once patched, can someone trigger the validator me? @dave?
dave: I'll kick it after the patch lands. If it passes, we can flip the onboard flag. Also noting we should add a rule to reject null for pad_token_id unless tokenizer explicitly maps to null.
maria: creating a tiny migration script to reconcile tokenizer -> config pad id and bump the asset manifest version.
sam: also leaving a comment in the model onboarding checklist: exporter guideline to not stringify numbers.
harper: perfect — appreciate the quick turn. please ping in this thread when done. :thumbsup:
anika: patch applied, validator ran, errors cleared. canary kickoff scheduled in 10m.
harper: awesome, closing this one after canary is green.
